title: [Master]-When we run the Order Planning Worksheet by Project, a supply suggestion is created for items that are already received but not invoiced in Purchase Orders, but only after updating Order and Posting Dates on Purchase Order.
summary: Fixes Order Planning Worksheet run by project creating supply suggestions for items already received but not invoiced on purchase orders, which happened after the order and posting dates on the purchase order were updated. The change is in the Get Unplanned Demand codeunit.
key_points: No supply suggestion for received but not invoiced purchase order items when planning by project
Issue appeared after updating Order and Posting Dates on the purchase order
